results.problem: Newton step for systems with banded elemental Jacobians
results.quote: Superiority of the matrix-free Newton method follows immediately for \(m\checkmark n\) as \(\mathcal{O}(qm^2n)<\mathcal{O}(qmn^2)\).

results.problem: Newton step for systems with tridiagonal elemental Jacobians
results.quote: The total computational cost of the matrix-free Newton method adds up to \(\mathcal{O}(qn)<\max(\mathcal{O}(qn^2),\mathcal{O}(n^3))\).
Theorem 4.9. Matrix-Free Newton Step is NP-complete.
